result.summary: The page layout is mostly coherent, but there is a clearly broken image in the 'Popular right now' section plus several truncation/consistency issues in the carousels and chip row.

issues.description: The first card in 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a grey broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, while the card below renders a proper image.
issues.suggestion: Fix the broken image URL, and add a branded fallback/skeleton (e.g. cuisine illustration or logo) instead of the generic broken-image glyph.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you' the third card is cut off mid-title ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, so it reads as clipped text rather than an intentional peeking carousel item.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis to card titles and align the carousel so partially visible cards are clipped at a consistent, deliberate offset (or add gradient/fade edge).

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing a sliver of the next chip with no visible affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/fade edge or arrow indicator so the scrollable chip row is discoverable and the cut chip isn't half-rendered.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) buttons are inconsistently styled: the top card uses a light grey semi-transparent circle with white heart (low contrast against the grey placeholder), the card below uses a dark circle.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button to a single style with a scrim/shadow that guarantees contrast on both light and dark thumbnails.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible bottom padding, making the list look cut off rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' cards mix info inside the image (badges like '€0 delivery' and '−20%') with no visible text alternative, and the broken image gives no context for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide alt text/labels for restaurant images and badges so promotional info is announced by assistive tech.
